name: read_code_flow
description: Read an explicitly authored feature hierarchy from code-flow.json. Omit feature_id for the catalog; select one feature for its current Rust call graph, shared nodes, source evidence, boundary/unresolved calls and declared test entries. Select node_id to read that node's exact source. Membership and responsibilities are declarations; call edges are syntax evidence, not compiler-proven or runtime coverage. This tool does not run tests or edit source. Update the manifest with normal file tools after analyzing source.
